description: Federal awards search (USAspending): Keyword search of US federal contracts, grants, loans or IDVs for a fiscal year, optionally filtered to one awarding agency, sorted by amount, from the USAspending.gov API (free, no key). Source: USAspending.gov. Not professional, legal, insurance, engineering, medical, financial or tax advice. Price: $0.005 USDC per call (x402 on Base). This hosted tool does NOT pay and does NOT return the deliverable: it validates the input and returns payment instructions (pay_to, network, price and the x402 URL to pay at). GET the url; read PAYMENT-REQUIRED from the 402; retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2). Or run the local x420-mcp server with your own wallet key to pay automatically. Deliverable once paid: JSON: count, has_more, awards[{award_id, recipient, amount_usd, awarding_agency, start_date, end_date, description, url}].

agency.description: awarding top-tier agency name, e.g. Department of Defense (default: any)
